title: Vision product search (TargetProductDetector)
purpose: Find the requested TargetProduct in a camera frame and return a structured, confidence-bearing observation with relative position and bounding box.
architecturalScope: VisualSearch bounded context. TargetProductDetector port with replaceable adapters (LocalVLM, CloudVLM, ObjectDetector, Hybrid). No training of dedicated detectors required for MVP.
domainContext: ProductCandidate, Observation, Confidence, BoundingBox, RelativePosition (horizontal/vertical). VLM output is mapped to these structured types.

milestones.title: Port + dummy adapter
milestones.description: Detector interface defined and testable without a model.

milestones.title: General-purpose VLM adapter
milestones.description: A strong general VLM finds the target and reports a bounding box.

milestones.title: Structured domain mapping
milestones.description: Free-form model output converts to ProductCandidate reliably.

tasks.title: Define TargetProductDetector port and ProductCandidate
acceptanceCriteria: Dummy adapter returns deterministic candidates for tests.

tasks.title: Implement LocalVLM/CloudVLM adapter (configurable)
evidence: app/tests/jev-live.test.ts green against running llama-server :18150 (Bonsai 27B, detected p=0.9998)

tasks.title: Build robust output-to-domain parser
acceptanceCriteria: Malformed model output yields an uncertain/no-detection result, never a fabricated one.
Detected candidates always carry confidence and relative position.
The port can be replaced by detector/embedding/OCR/barcode adapters without domain changes.
No free-form model text is passed to guidance.

risks.description: VLM hallucinates a product or position.
risks.mitigation: Structured output contract, confidence thresholds, no claim below threshold.

risks.description: Latency/cost of VLM make the loop sluggish.
risks.mitigation: Configurable sampling, cheap preprocessing, temporal tracking.

safetyImplications: A detection without sufficient confidence must not be announced as fact (AGENTS.md 19).
accessibilityImplications: Detection results feed non-visual guidance; no visual-only output.
privacyImplications: Cloud VLM is optional, explicit and never required; frames are ephemeral.
verificationRequirements: Adapter contract tests with malformed responses.
Detection accuracy evaluation on a labelled product set.

decisionLog.decision: Use a general-purpose VLM as the initial adapter rather than training a per-store detector.
decisionLog.rationale: Avoids training a detector for every supermarket product while the port keeps later replacement open.

decisionLog.decision: Default vision adapter is JevVisionDecisionDetector against ananta888/llama.cpp-vision-decision /v1/decision (Jev mode: mode=tree, return_probs).
decisionLog.rationale: Returns per-field calibrated probabilities and abstain, which feed the safety/confidence model directly; no free text is generated.
